downgrade_corrections_from_inspector_A.correction: DOI plus source_row_id is insufficient for full joined-table provenance. Require DOI/table/figure/SI/path plus row or digitized point id before status can become present.

downgrade_corrections_from_inspector_A.round1_gap: synthetic_label_flag and material_validation_allowed were not explicit in required_fields_status
downgrade_corrections_from_inspector_A.correction: Both fields are now row-level gates; missing synthetic_label_flag or material_validation_allowed blocks the row.

downgrade_corrections_from_inspector_A.round1_gap: forbidden_namespace=oi;graph was semantically useful but not mechanically clean
downgrade_corrections_from_inspector_A.correction: The multi-namespace rule is split into separate executable OI and graph rule changes below; a parser must not treat semicolon-delimited namespaces as a single opaque namespace.
Carrier density must be audited at row level for same-measurement sigma/(n*e) inversion before use with Hall mobility targets.
No Srivastava reproduction, fixed-density/fixed-pair comparison, or graph-beats-baseline statement is allowed until OI_raw_sum, exact normalization, and row-to-structure mapping are present.

new_rules.audit_condition: forbidden as independent graph-claim predictors unless used only inside predeclared OI residualization/baseline computation
forbidden as independent graph evidence unless pair-density/cell-volume matching or held-out residual binning is explicitly recorded

executable_forbidden_rule_changes.parser_requirement: Audit parser must evaluate each split namespace row independently and emit pass, fail, or not_applicable with a reason.

new_rule.audit_condition: row must declare OI_comparison_mode in {fixed_density, fixed_pair, no_claim}; fixed_density requires OI_norm plus pair_density control, fixed_pair requires OI_pair_mean and fixed N_pair provenance, and no_claim keeps the row context-only.
fail if B0_carrier_density_independence_status is same_measurement_inversion_forbidden or unknown_blocked; pass only if independent or not_applicable with declared non-Hall target.
fail if the effective-mass target value or an algebraic copy is present as a model control or graph feature; allow only as the held-out label.

decision_order.logic: If any required template field is missing, row_decision=blocked_context_only and material_validation_allowed=false.
If label_provenance_id lacks DOI/table/figure/SI/path plus row or point id, row_decision=blocked_context_only and material_validation_allowed=false.
If structure_or_SI_source, structure_id, or num_atoms_or_snapshot_size is missing or not same-sample, row_decision=blocked_context_only and material_validation_allowed=false.

If O_s_or_exact_overlap_baseline is only reported OI_norm, allow context-only status. If a reproduced O_s or fixed-density/fixed-pair claim is attempted without OI_raw_sum, OI_normalization_formula_id, pair_density, and required mode fields, row_decision=blocked_context_only.
If any B0 field is missing without declared missingness, derived from the target, same-measurement inverted, or lacks row-level independence status where required, material_validation_allowed=false.
If any G1 metric is missing without declaration, computed under conventions chosen after labels, or lacks budget/matched-random controls, material_validation_allowed=false.
If synthetic_label_flag is missing or true, row_decision=diagnostic_only_synthetic and material_validation_allowed=false.
Run all applicable forbidden rules after parser expansion. If any rule fails or parser semantics are unknown, row_decision=failed_forbidden_control and material_validation_allowed=false.

Only if steps 1-8 pass may row_decision=pass_for_material_validation and material_validation_allowed=true; this Round 2 template expects existing Srivastava A rows to remain blocked_context_only until provenance is upgraded.

default_for_current_A_round1_Srivastava_.reason: label_provenance_id is partial, structure/SI mapping is absent, OI_raw_sum and exact normalization are absent, and no executable forbidden-control audit can pass on incomplete rows.

remaining_blockers.needed_before_unblock: DOI/table/figure/SI/path plus row or digitized point id for each label value.
structure_or_SI_source, structure_id, num_atoms_or_snapshot_size, and same-sample key for each Srivastava row.

remaining_blockers.blocker: Exact Srivastava O_s normalization is not executable
remaining_blockers.needed_before_unblock: formula/source path, raw overlap sum, pair cutoff, weighting rule, volume or N_pair denominator, and reproduced OI_norm check.

remaining_blockers.blocker: Fixed-density versus fixed-pair mode cannot be audited
remaining_blockers.needed_before_unblock: OI_comparison_mode, pair_density, cell_volume_m3, OI_pair_mean where applicable, and N_pair provenance.

remaining_blockers.blocker: B0 controls are not row-level independent
remaining_blockers.needed_before_unblock: independent source or declared missingness for onsite variance, carrier density, mobility-edge margin, finite size, and batch/family; carrier density needs explicit inversion-leakage status.

remaining_blockers.blocker: G1 graph metrics have no provenance-complete real structure row
remaining_blockers.needed_before_unblock: L_sym lambda2, budget-normalized rho_A, and matched attack gap computed from a fixed convention before labels are read.

remaining_blockers.blocker: Forbidden-control audit is not executable on incomplete rows
remaining_blockers.needed_before_unblock: split namespace rules, row-level target type, namespaces, candidate feature/control columns, and pass/fail/not_applicable output for every rule.

remaining_blockers.blocker: synthetic_label_flag and material_validation_allowed must be explicit row fields
remaining_blockers.needed_before_unblock: populate both fields for every row and derive material_validation_allowed rather than manually asserting it.

allowed_claims: This artifact is an A-side row-level audit template draft for Srivastava/OI baseline rows.
Existing A Round 1 Srivastava rows are baseline context candidates, not reproduced Srivastava O_s rows.
Existing A Round 1 Srivastava rows should be treated as blocked_context_only until row-level provenance and executable audits are complete.
Forbidden-control rules require split namespace handling or explicit parser semantics before pass/fail automation.
forbidden_claims: Do not claim material validation from this Round 2 template.
Do not claim graph metrics beat Srivastava/OI baseline.
Do not claim exact Srivastava O_s reproduction before OI_raw_sum, exact normalization, and row-to-structure mapping are present.
Do not claim fixed-density or fixed-pair OI effects from reported OI_norm alone.
Do not treat carrier density as an allowed Hall-mobility control without row-level independence audit.
